sources.title: GLM-MoE-DSA and Other Models | ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: GLM-MoE-DSA is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model utilizing Dynamic Sparse Attention (DSA). In VeOmni, this model is implemented by patching the HuggingFace transformers (v5.2.0+) implementation to support optimized training paths, such as fused cross-entropy loss and hardware-specific kernels.
